name: sloptv-ai-video-benchmark
title: SlopTV AI video benchmark scores and prices
description: Independent benchmark scores and published prices for AI video generation models.

resources.name: leaderboard
resources.description: One row per model: overall score, 95% confidence interval, sub-scores and the score in each test category.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Position by overall score (1 = best)

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model name

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Model id, also used in https://sloptv.co/model/{slug}

fields.name: company
fields.description: Maker

fields.name: overall
fields.description: Mean overall score across all clips, 0 to 5

fields.name: ci95
fields.description: Half-width of the 95% confidence interval of overall

fields.name: fidelity
fields.description: Prompt fidelity, 0 to 5

fields.name: visual
fields.description: Visual quality, 0 to 5

fields.name: physics
fields.description: Physical plausibility, 0 to 5

fields.name: consistency
fields.description: Temporal and identity consistency, 0 to 5

fields.name: audio
fields.description: Audio quality and sync, 0 to 5 (empty when the model has no audio)

fields.name: attempts_until_usable
fields.description: Mean generations needed for a usable clip (empty when not recorded)

fields.name: runs
fields.description: Clips scored

fields.name: hands
fields.description: Overall score within that test category (hands, faces, liquids, text_render, multishot, lipsync, camera, animals, style, img2video)

resources.name: scores
resources.description: One row per scored clip: model, prompt, category, round and every judge score, with a link to the clip.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model name

fields.name: model_slug
fields.description: Model id

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Prompt id, also used in https://sloptv.co/test/{prompt}

fields.name: category
fields.description: Test category

fields.name: round
fields.description: Benchmark round label

fields.name: score_overall
fields.description: Overall score, 0 to 5

fields.name: score_fidelity
fields.description: Prompt fidelity

fields.name: score_visual
fields.description: Visual quality

fields.name: score_physics

fields.description: Consistency

fields.description: Audio

fields.name: resolution

fields.name: has_audio

fields.name: run_at
fields.description: Generation date (UTC)

fields.name: clip_page

resources.name: prices
resources.description: Current published prices on every platform and API we track, normalised to USD per clip and per second.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model name

fields.name: model_slug
fields.description: Model id, also used in https://sloptv.co/radar/{model_slug}

fields.name: platform
fields.description: Platform or API selling it

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Model tier or speed mode as sold

fields.name: task
fields.description: Text-to-video, image-to-video, etc. (empty when the price is the same for all)

fields.name: resolution
fields.description: Output resolution

fields.name: audio
fields.description: 1 if the price includes generated audio

fields.name: duration_s
fields.description: Clip length the price refers to

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Subscription plan the credit price is computed on (empty for pay-as-you-go APIs)

fields.name: plan_usd_month
fields.description: Monthly price of that plan in USD

fields.name: usd_per_clip
fields.description: Cost of one clip of duration_s seconds, USD

fields.name: usd_per_second
fields.description: Same, per second of video

fields.name: is_entry_plan
fields.description: 1 for the cheapest plan that can run the model

fields.name: is_best_plan
fields.description: 1 for the plan with the lowest cost per clip

fields.name: exact
fields.description: 1 if read directly from the published price, 0 if derived (for example scaled to another clip length)

fields.name: promo
fields.description: 1 if it is a time-limited promotional price
